versions.changelog: v1.4.0: 회의록 파싱으로 액션 아이템 추출 및 리마인더 추천 기능 추가. 4개 언어(en/ko/ja/zh) 패턴 매칭 지원. GitHub: https://github.com/swancho/mac-reminders-agent
Add multiple lists, priority levels, and title search
Add edit, delete, complete commands. List now returns IDs via EventKit. License changed to MIT.

- Added a `package.json` for standardized Node.js dependency management and easier installation.
- Updated documentation and metadata (SKILL.md, README.md) to include explicit system requirements, permissions, and installation instructions.
- Clarified macOS Reminders permission handling and provided troubleshooting steps in documentation.
- Minor corrections and clean up in various files (CHANGELOG.md, cli.js) for clarity and consistency.
Fix: timezone handling (any offset), Swift error propagation
Native recurrence via Swift EventKit. Detailed repeat labels (매주 화요일, Every Tuesday)

Version 1.1.0 (mac-reminders-agent)

- Added multi-language support (English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese) for trigger phrases and response formatting.
- Users can now manage reminders in their native language, with automatic or explicit language detection.
- Expanded commands for listing (today/week/all) and adding reminders, with locale-specific templates.
- Improved natural language trigger coverage for listing and adding reminders.
- Enhanced error handling with locale-aware messages and fallback suggestions.
